module: Wireframe and surface rendering of splines and layers for the spline editing tools (most of the old render.lua). Composite module: draws via render/spheres, lines, tris and markup, with its own pool of temporary vec3s. handleSplineRendering draws nodes, names, ribs, bars and elevations; the other functions draw hulls, ribbons, surfaces conformed to or projected onto the ground, and previews. To be called every frame from an editor tool.
notes: An expected spline is a table with nodes, divPoints (subdivided points), divWidths, binormals, isEnabled, isLink, isLoop, isPolyline, etc.; the exact fields come from the calling tool.
The projected surfaces (renderDrivePathSurface) cast a vertical raycast from 3 m above (zRayLift) and add 0.05 m (zRayOffset); they are skipped for isLink splines.
A twist arc is drawn in 16 segments, at 0.97 * 5 m from the center.
A half-spline (tileSet or spacing field present) draws only the right-hand ribs (even indices).

drawArc.desc: Draws a circular arc (16 segments) from point a to point b around center, with the twist angle label in the middle for the selected node.

isSelectedNode.desc: true to display the twist angle.

twistAngle.desc: Twist angle; its sign gives the direction of the arc.

drawRibPoints.desc: Draws the rib points (spheres) and rib lines: for a full spline, left and right connected; for a half-spline, only the right edge connected to the center node.

spline.desc: Spline (tileSet or spacing signals a half-spline; nodes).

drawBarPoints.desc: Draws the bar handles and their drop line to the ground (vertical raycast), colored according to elevation. No effect if there are fewer than 2 bars.

elevScale.desc: Height corresponding to the red of the ramp.

handleSplineRendering.desc: Draws all splines: the selected one with its nodes, highlight, gizmo/rotation, ribs, bars, elevation and name/length; the others in dimmed form with their name.

hiddenNodeSet.desc: Set of nodes of the selected spline whose large sphere, highlight and elevation line are suppressed (engineered corners of heroRoad where the PI node is far from the road).

noNames.desc: Suppresses the name of unselected splines (networks of hundreds of links).

renderLayer.desc: Draws the wireframe of a spline layer (with binormal offset), optionally projected onto the ground by raycast.

isRaycast.desc: Project the points onto the ground.

binormalSpacing.desc: Spacing of the binormal lines, in division points.

renderMasterLayer.desc: Like renderLayer for a master spline layer, without applying the binormal offset.

renderShells.desc: Draws the hulls of splines (simple wireframe with labels) when the tool is inactive.

renderHalfSplineWireFrame.desc: Draws the wireframe of half-splines (e.g. sidewalks).

renderWireframeRibbons.desc: Draws a wireframe outline of the given splines.

renderHomologatedSurface.desc: Draws the wireframe of master splines, with a heat-map surface for the selected spline.

renderDrivePathSurface.desc: Draws a quadrilateral wireframe surface whose z values are obtained by raycast onto the ground, along divPoints (every other line).

renderPreviewRibbon.desc: Draws a preview ribbon: node spheres, width and edge lines and preview surface. The binormals are computed in 2D (horizontal).

widths.desc: Ribbon width at each node, in meters.

renderSplinePolylines.desc: Draws the polylines of the mesh, assembly, rail and decal spline tools: thick stroke for the selected spline, dimmed for the others. An isPolyline spline is drawn through its nodes (closed if isLoop), otherwise through divPoints; disabled or isLink splines are skipped.
